resources.string: Keeps Meta AI Glasses camera streaming active while HoldUp is in use
HoldUp is streaming from your glasses
Privacy notice: Glasses camera is streaming and the front hardware capture LED is illuminated. Frames stream at roughly 1 frame per second into server RAM only and are never stored on disk.
Server URL input field, enter public HTTPS tunnel or local server origin
Session Code input field, leave blank to follow latest active session
